description.p: PneuGineer is a pneumatic circuit editor and simulator for learning and teaching pneumatics and electro-pneumatics. Drag valves, cylinders and air supplies onto a canvas, wire them together with ISO 1219 symbols and run the simulation: pressures build up and fall, and throttles and loads set how fast the cylinders move.

ul.li: Directional valves operated by hand, by air, by solenoid or by roller
AND and OR valves, timers, counters and pressure sequence valves
Flow controls, quick exhaust valves, pressure regulators and flow meters
Cylinders with loads, moving masses, friction or efficiency, and sensors
Electrical control: push buttons, relays, solenoids, sensors and a small PLC
Ready-made example circuits to start from, and several circuits open at once in tabs
Export to PDF, PNG and SVG, one circuit or many, and record a video of a simulation

description.p: The simulation is a simplified model for education. It is not a design or safety tool.
